questions.q: In the price variance exception, why can't Chen simply pay the invoice billed 8% above the purchase order price?
options: Because Oracle Fusion Cloud does not allow any price above the original requisition estimate
Because it falls outside the configured price tolerance, failing 3-way matching and creating a matching hold that must be resolved first
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. is not a registered supplier
Because the purchase order was never approved
questions.explain: An 8% price variance outside tolerance fails matching and creates a hold, blocking payment until the discrepancy is resolved with the supplier.

questions.q: In the quantity variance exception, how many units does Priya record on the receipt when Meridian ships only 45 of the 50 ordered?
options: 50 units, matching the original order regardless of what arrived
0 units, since a partial shipment cannot be received
45 units, reflecting only what actually physically arrived
55 units, to account for an anticipated future overage
questions.explain: A receipt should always reflect physical reality - Priya receives exactly the 45 units that arrived, not the originally ordered 50.

questions.q: What happens to the purchase order's status while only 45 of 50 bearings have been received?
options: It becomes Finally Closed immediately
It reverts back to a requisition
It is automatically cancelled
It remains Open rather than progressing to Closed for Receiving, since the full ordered quantity has not yet been received
questions.explain: Since the full quantity has not been received, the purchase order cannot yet progress to Closed for Receiving - it remains Open.

questions.q: Why is a post-payment return (defective bearings discovered after the invoice was already paid) harder to resolve than a pre-invoice return?
options: Because cash has already moved and the accounting has already posted, typically requiring a debit memo or credit processed separately rather than simply reversing the receipt and invoice
It is not actually any harder; the process is identical in both cases
Because post-payment returns are not supported by Oracle Fusion Cloud under any circumstances
Because only the original requester can initiate a return, and by this point they are unavailable
questions.explain: Once cash and accounting have already moved, a return typically requires a separate debit memo or credit process rather than a simple reversal of the original transaction.

questions.q: What is the next course in the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path after Oracle Fusion Procure-to-Pay?
options: Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting
Oracle Fusion General Ledger
Oracle Fusion Fixed Assets
Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash
questions.explain: Per the path's End-to-End Business Processes stage, Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash follows Procure-to-Pay, before Subledger Accounting.
